from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        ]

        priv_text_leo = Text("Private", font_size=12, color="#00FF00").next_to(priv_leo, UP, buff=0.1)
        
        dp3t_label = Text("DP-3T: Privacy-First", font_size=24, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(dp3t_label, "C3", "D4")

        self.play(
            FadeOut(server),
            FadeOut(line_pip),
            FadeOut(line_leo),
            Create(priv_pip),
            Create(priv_leo),
            Write(priv_text_pip),
            Write(priv_text_leo)
        )
        
        self.play(Write(dp3t_label))
        self.wait(2)

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup the scene with title and lecture lines
        lecture_lines = [
            'Cryptographic hashing turns inputs into unique strings.',
            'These one-way functions cannot be reversed.',
            'A secret seed generates unpredictable rolling codes.'
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite: One-Way Hash Functions", lecture_lines)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight first line
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[1:3].animate.set_color(GRAY))
        
        # Create Blender (Hash Function)
        blender_body = Polygon(
            [-0.8, 1, 0], [0.8, 1, 0], [0.5, -1, 0], [-0.5, -1, 0],
            color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.2
        )
        blender_label = Text("Hash Function", font_size=20, color=WHITE)
        blender = VGroup(blender_body, blender_label)
        self.place_in_area(blender, "C3", "D4", scale_factor=0.8)
        blender_label.next_to(blender_body, DOWN, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Create(blender_body), Write(blender_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight second line
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(GRAY), self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(GRAY))
        
        # Create a "One-Way" indicator (Red Arrow)
        one_way_arrow = Arrow(
            start=self.grid["B3"], end=self.grid["E3"], 
            color=RED, stroke_width=8, buff=0.1
        ).shift(LEFT * 0.8)
        one_way_label = Text("ONE-WAY", font_size=18, color=RED).rotate(90*DEGREES).next_to(one_way_arrow, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(one_way_arrow), Write(one_way_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Highlight third line
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[0:2].animate.set_color(GRAY))
        
        # Seed Block
        seed_box = Square(side_length=0.6, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8)
        seed_text = Text("Seed", font_size=16, color=BLACK)
        seed = VGroup(seed_box, seed_text)
        self.place_at_grid(seed, "B3")
        
        # Rolling Codes (Output)
        code_strings = ["0x8F2A", "0x3C1B", "0x9E7D"]
        codes = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(
                RoundedRectangle(height=0.4, width=1.2, corner_radius=0.1, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.8),
                Text(s, font_size=16, color=BLACK)
            ) for s in code_strings
        ]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.2)
        self.place_at_grid(codes, "E3")
        
        # Animation: Seed enters Blender, Codes come out
        self.play(FadeIn(seed, shift=DOWN))
        self.play(seed.animate.move_to(blender_body.get_center()).set_opacity(0), run_time=1)
        
        # Shake blender
        self.play(blender_body.animate.shift(LEFT*0.1), run_time=0.05)
        self.play(blender_body.animate.shift(RIGHT*0.2), run_time=0.05)
        self.play(blender_body.animate.shift(LEFT*0.1), run_time=0.05)
        
        # Flow out codes
        for code in codes:
            self.play(
                FadeIn(code, target_position=blender_body.get_center()),
                code.animate.move_to(code.get_center()),
                run_time=0.5
            )
        
        self.wait(2)

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Initial Setup
        title = "The Daily Secret & Rolling IDs"
        lines = [
            "Each day, phones generate a new Secret Day Key.",
            "This key derives Rolling Proximity Identifiers every fifteen minutes.",
            "Frequent rotation prevents tracking by malicious observers.",
            "To others, Pip's ID looks like a total stranger."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # Colors
        COLOR_SK = "#FFA500"  # Secret Key Orange
        COLOR_RPI = "#00FFFF" # RPI Cyan
        COLOR_HIGHLIGHT = YELLOW

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Pip's phone icon containing a 'Secret Day Key'
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT))
        
        phone_body = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.2, height=2.5, width=1.5, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(phone_body, "B2", "D3")
        
        sk_label = Text("SK_t", font_size=24, color=COLOR_SK)
        self.place_at_grid(sk_label, "C2", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        sk_box = SurroundingRectangle(sk_label, color=COLOR_SK, buff=0.1)
        phone_group = VGroup(phone_body, sk_label, sk_box)
        
        self.play(Create(phone_body))
        self.play(FadeIn(sk_label), Create(sk_box))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # A code 'A12B' pulses from the phone with a '10:00 AM' timestamp.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
        )
        
        rpi_1 = Text("A12B", font_size=32, color=COLOR_RPI)
        self.place_at_grid(rpi_1, "B5")
        
        time_1 = Text("10:00 AM", font_size=20, color=GRAY)
        self.place_at_grid(time_1, "C5")
        
        arrow_1 = Arrow(start=self.grid["C3"], end=self.grid["C5"], color=COLOR_RPI)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow_1))
        self.play(FadeIn(rpi_1), FadeIn(time_1))
        self.play(rpi_1.animate.scale(1.2), run_time=0.5, rate_func=there_and_back)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # The code 'A12B' changes to 'C99X' with a '10:15 AM' timestamp.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
        )
        
        rpi_2 = Text("C99X", font_size=32, color=COLOR_RPI)
        self.place_at_grid(rpi_2, "B5")
        
        time_2 = Text("10:15 AM", font_size=20, color=GRAY)
        self.place_at_grid(time_2, "C5")
        
        self.play(
            Transform(rpi_1, rpi_2),
            Transform(time_1, time_2)
        )
        self.play(rpi_1.animate.scale(1.2), run_time=0.5, rate_func=there_and_back)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # To others, Pip's ID looks like a total stranger.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
        )
        
        # Add a "Stranger" icon/text to emphasize anonymity
        stranger_label = Text("Unknown", font_size=24, color=RED)
        self.place_at_grid(stranger_label, "E5")
        
        eye_icon = VGroup(
            Ellipse(width=0.8, height=0.4, color=WHITE),
            Dot(color=WHITE)
        )
        self.place_at_grid(eye_icon, "E4")
        
        self.play(FadeIn(eye_icon), Write(stranger_label))
        
        # Flash both RPIs to show they are disconnected
        self.play(Indicate(rpi_1, color=COLOR_RPI))
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Final cleanup highlight
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        self.wait(1)

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout(
            "The Digital Handshake (Log Storage)", 
            [
                "Nearby phones exchange rolling IDs via Bluetooth.", 
                "Observed codes are stored in a local, encrypted diary.", 
                "No location data or identities are ever recorded."
            ]
        )

        # --- Setup Mobjects ---
        # Phone creation
        def create_phone(label_text, color=WHITE):
            phone_body = RoundedRectangle(height=1.2, width=0.7, corner_radius=0.1, color=color)
            screen = Rectangle(height=0.9, width=0.55, color=color).move_to(phone_body.get_center())
            label = Text(label_text, font_size=14, color=color).next_to(phone_body, UP, buff=0.1)
            return VGroup(phone_body, screen, label)

        pip_phone = create_phone("Pip", WHITE)
        leo_phone = create_phone("Leo", WHITE)

        # Bluetooth waves
        def create_waves(center_obj, color="#ADD8E6"):
            waves = VGroup(*[
                Circle(radius=0.1 + i * 0.2, stroke_width=2, color=color, stroke_opacity=1 - i*0.3)
                for i in range(3)
            ])
            waves.add_updater(lambda m: m.move_to(center_obj.get_center()))
            return waves

        pip_waves = create_waves(pip_phone)
        leo_waves = create_waves(leo_phone)

        # Diary Folder
        diary_folder = VGroup(
            Rectangle(width=0.8, height=0.6, fill_opacity=0.3, color="#90EE90"),
            Polygon([0,0,0], [0.3,0,0], [0.2,0.1,0], [0,0.1,0], color="#90EE90").shift(UP*0.3 + LEFT*0.25)
        )
        diary_label = Text("Local Diary", font_size=12, color="#90EE90").next_to(diary_folder, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        diary_group = VGroup(diary_folder, diary_label)

        # Code ID
        code_id = Text("A12B", font_size=18, color=WHITE)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#ADD8E6")
        
        # Positions
        self.place_at_grid(pip_phone, "B1")
        self.place_at_grid(leo_phone, "E6")
        
        self.add(pip_phone, leo_phone)
        
        # Pulse animation
        def pulse_anim(m):
            for circle in m:
                circle.scale(1.05)
                if circle.width > 1.2:
                    circle.scale(0.1 / circle.radius)
        
        pip_waves.add_updater(pulse_anim)
        leo_waves.add_updater(pulse_anim)
        
        self.play(
            pip_phone.animate.move_to(self.grid["B6"]),
            leo_phone.animate.move_to(self.grid["E1"]),
            FadeIn(pip_waves),
            FadeIn(leo_waves),
            run_time=4
        )
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#90EE90")
        
        # Diary appears near Leo's current position (E1 region)
        # Leo is now near E1. Let's place diary at D1.
        self.place_at_grid(diary_group, "D2", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(diary_group),
            pip_waves.animate.set_stroke(opacity=0),
            leo_waves.animate.set_stroke(opacity=0),
            run_time=1
        )
        pip_waves.clear_updaters()
        leo_waves.clear_updaters()
        self.remove(pip_waves, leo_waves)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Technically the prompt asks for code movement for line 3
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE) # Defaulting to white for emphasis
        
        # Code starts at Pip's phone (now at B6) and moves to Leo's Diary (at D2)
        self.place_at_grid(code_id, "B6")
        
        self.play(
            code_id.animate.move_to(diary_group.get_center()).scale(0.5),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.play(
            FadeOut(code_id),
            diary_group.animate.scale(1.1).set_color(YELLOW),
            run_time=0.5
        )
        self.play(
            diary_group.animate.scale(1/1.1).set_color("#90EE90"),
            run_time=0.5
        )
        
        # Cross out "Location/Identity" visualization for Line 3
        no_gps = VGroup(
            Text("GPS", font_size=16, color=RED),
            Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=RED).rotate(45),
            Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=RED).rotate(-45)
        )
        self.place_at_grid(no_gps, "F3")
        self.play(FadeIn(no_gps))
        
        self.wait(2)

class Section7Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup layout
        lines = [
            'DP-3T ensures matching happens only on your device.',
            'The server never learns who met whom.',
            'Cryptography secures health data against surveillance.'
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Summary: Privacy by Design", lines)

        # Helper to create a lock
        def get_lock(color="#FFD700"):
            body = Square(side_length=0.2, fill_opacity=1, color=color, stroke_width=1)
            shackle = Arc(radius=0.08, start_angle=0, angle=PI, color=color, stroke_width=2).shift(UP*0.1)
            return VGroup(body, shackle)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#00FF00")
        
        # Centralized Web
        cent_color = "#FF4444"
        cent_server = Dot(color=cent_color, radius=0.15)
        self.place_at_grid(cent_server, "C2")
        
        cent_nodes = VGroup(*[Dot(color=cent_color, radius=0.1) for _ in range(4)])
        self.place_at_grid(cent_nodes[0], "B1")
        self.place_at_grid(cent_nodes[1], "B3")
        self.place_at_grid(cent_nodes[2], "D1")
        self.place_at_grid(cent_nodes[3], "D3")
        
        cent_lines = VGroup(*[Line(cent_server.get_center(), node.get_center(), color=cent_color, stroke_width=2) for node in cent_nodes])
        
        cent_label = Text("Centralized", font_size=18, color=cent_color)
        self.place_in_area(cent_label, "A1", "A3")
        
        # Decentralized Dots
        dec_color = "#00FF00"
        dec_nodes = VGroup(*[Dot(color=dec_color, radius=0.1) for _ in range(4)])
        self.place_at_grid(dec_nodes[0], "B5")
        self.place_at_grid(dec_nodes[1], "C4")
        self.place_at_grid(dec_nodes[2], "D6")
        self.place_at_grid(dec_nodes[3], "E5")
        
        dec_label = Text("DP-3T (Local)", font_size=18, color=dec_color)
        self.place_in_area(dec_label, "A4", "A6")
        
        # Divider line
        divider = DashedLine(self.grid["A4"] + LEFT*0.5 + UP*0.5, self.grid["F4"] + LEFT*0.5 + DOWN*0.5, color=GREY)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(cent_label), FadeIn(cent_server), Create(cent_lines), FadeIn(cent_nodes),
            FadeIn(dec_label), FadeIn(dec_nodes),
            Create(divider)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FFD700")
        
        # Handshakes in decentralized area
        handshake1 = Line(dec_nodes[0].get_center(), dec_nodes[1].get_center(), color=dec_color, stroke_width=2)
        handshake2 = Line(dec_nodes[2].get_center(), dec_nodes[3].get_center(), color=dec_color, stroke_width=2)
        
        lock1 = get_lock("#FFD700")
        lock2 = get_lock("#FFD700")
        lock1.move_to(handshake1.get_center())
        lock2.move_to(handshake2.get_center())

        self.play(
            Create(handshake1), Create(handshake2),
            FadeIn(lock1), FadeIn(lock2),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#00FF00")
        
        privacy_text = Text("Privacy by Design", color="#00FF00", font_size=32)
        self.place_in_area(privacy_text, "C2", "D5")
        
        # Glow and scale effect
        self.play(
            Write(privacy_text),
            privacy_text.animate.scale(1.3),
            Indicate(privacy_text, color="#00FF00", scale_factor=1.1),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(2)

outline.target_audience: University students in Computer Science or Cybersecurity

sections.title: The Privacy Paradox
sections.content: Introduction to the challenge of contact tracing: How can we track exposure to a virus without creating a 'Big Brother' surveillance state? Contrast the Centralized model (where a server knows everyone's location) with the Decentralized (DP-3T) model.
sections.example: Imagine two animals, Pip the Penguin and Leo the Lion, passing each other in a forest. They want to be able to warn each other if they get sick later, but they don't want a 'Forest King' server to know exactly when or where they met.

sections.title: Prerequisite: One-Way Hash Functions
sections.content: Explanation of cryptographic hashing and seeds. Visualizing a 'Secret Shaker': you put a secret key in, and it generates a unique, unpredictable string of numbers. Crucially, you can't go backwards from the numbers to the key.
sections.example: A mathematical 'blender' icon: Inputting a 'Seed of the Day' produces a sequence of 'Rolling Codes' that look like random noise to anyone watching.

sections.title: The Daily Secret & Rolling IDs
sections.content: Every day, Pip’s phone generates a 'Secret Day Key' (SKt). From this key, the phone derives 'Rolling Proximity Identifiers' (RPIs) that change every 15 minutes. This prevents someone from tracking Pip throughout the day using a static ID.
sections.example: Pip’s phone broadcasts 'A12B' at 10:00 AM and 'C99X' at 10:15 AM. To Leo, these look like two completely different strangers.

sections.title: The Digital Handshake (Log Storage)
sections.content: When Pip and Leo are close, their phones exchange these RPIs via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). Each phone stores the IDs it *hears* in a local, encrypted 'Diary' folder. No location data (GPS) is ever recorded.
sections.example: Leo’s phone 'hears' Pip's RPI and whispers to its internal storage: 'I saw code A12B today at a signal strength of -70dB.' Leo’s phone doesn't know this code belongs to Pip.

sections.title: Sounding the Alarm: The Diagnosis Upload
sections.content: If Pip tests positive, he uploads his 'Secret Day Keys' for the last 14 days to a central server. Note: He does NOT upload his contacts. The server only hosts a list of 'Sick Keys'—not identities.
sections.example: Pip sends his 'Secret Day Key' (the seed) to a public bulletin board. The board shows: 'The owner of the seed that produced these codes is sick,' but the board doesn't know who Pip met.

sections.title: Local Matching: The Private Detective
sections.content: Every phone periodically downloads the new 'Sick Keys' from the server. Leo's phone uses these keys to recreate all possible RPIs that the sick person *would* have broadcasted. It then compares these to the codes in its local 'Diary'.
sections.example: Leo's phone runs the 'Secret Shaker' math on Pip's uploaded key. It generates 'A12B'. It checks the Diary, finds 'A12B', and alerts Leo: 'You were near someone who is now sick!'

sections.title: Summary: Privacy by Design
sections.content: Recap of why DP-3T is secure: 1. Identities stay on devices. 2. The server never sees the 'Handshake'. 3. All matching happens locally. The math ensures that even the government can't reconstruct the social graph.
sections.example: A split-screen visual: On the left, a Centralized 'Web' connecting everyone. On the right, DP-3T shows isolated dots that only connect momentarily on their own terms.
